name: Ocean Escape
detailed_description:
Death isn't the end... it's the beginning of your payback.

Welcome to The Expendable Project. To your android overlords, you're a disposable asset. But in this broken world, you are your own last hope.

YOUR WORLD. YOUR MISSION.

Ocean Escape is a Third-Person Survival-Extraction Shooter where you must risk it all for greater rewards. The third-person perspective gives you maximum tactical awareness of your surroundings, allowing you to plan your every move.

Your goal is an addictive gameplay loop:

  • 1. DEPLOY: Gear up with weapons and equipment, then deploy to deadly islands teeming with zombies and priceless loot.

  • 2. LOOT: Brave the zombie hordes, complete missions, and scavenge for every last resource you can find. The greater the risk, the better the reward.

  • 3. EXTRACT: The real fight is getting out alive. Reach the extraction point with your haul intact. If you die, you lose it all.

  • 4. EVOLVE: Use your earnings to craft new weapons, upgrade your gear, and unlock powerful skills, making you even deadlier for the next run.

KEY FEATURES FOR YOUR SURVIVAL

AN UNFORGIVING WORLD
Face a variety of mutated zombie types and environmental hazards that will test your wits and skill at every turn.

[▼ Click to view additional threat data [CLASSIFIED]]

Intel - The Lurkers: Field analysis reveals a high mutation rate within the virus, resulting in diverse Lurker strains. These range from the ranged "Spitter" to the heavily armored "Brute." Engaging without prior intel is a top-tier risk.

EVOLVE OR BE REPLACED
Death provides lessons and data for your next clone. Customize your playstyle with a deep upgrade and skill system. Will you build a brawling powerhouse, a stealthy sharpshooter, or an expert scavenger?

A DEEP LORE & MYSTERY
This world has secrets. Collect data logs, audio diaries, and environmental clues to piece together what truly happened... and the true purpose of your creators.

Are you ready to break the cycle? Add the game to your wishlist and await activation.
